description: Search (or list) contacts and companies. With no search_terms, returns everything visible, paged. Returns { HasMoreResults, Results }. LACRM: GetContacts.

advanced_filters.description: AdvancedFilters, ANDed together. See https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/api_docs/v2/Advanced/Filter_Contacts for the names/operations your account supports.

Name.description: Filter name, e.g. FullName, FirstName, Group.

Operation.description: Operation, e.g. Contains, IsExactly, IsInGroupList, IsEmpty.

Value.description: Value for the operation (omit for IsEmpty-style operations).

owner_user_ids.description: Only records assigned to these UserIds.

search_terms.description: Text to search for across record fields (name, email, phone, company...).

name: lacrm_search_contacts
title: Search contacts and companies
